channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Police in Japan to share data on scam accounts with financial firms
item.description: Losses from special fraud nationwide are on track to exceed last year's record high, the National Police Agency said.

item.title: Bank of Japan’s 2% inflation-target victory fails to impress
item.description: After more than a decade of waiting, the market takes the data point as just another number to crunch.

item.title: U.S. Marine dies during training in Okinawa
item.description: The cause of death "is still under investigation," said a spokesman for the 3rd Marine Division.

item.title: Tokyo braces for fallout from the U.S. midterms
item.description: While relations are well-insulated from executive action due to bipartisan support, Tokyo will watch for changes in post-election decision-making.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
